typesense:trending.greeting:
The convoy thundered through the valley, engines screaming as enemy trucks closed in behind them. Bullets tore through the dust while explosions shook the road beneath their tires.

"They're not letting up!" Gaz yelled, returning fire through the rear hatch.

Soap glanced skyward, his expression falling. "Price..."

A swarm of drones crested the ridgeline.

Missile pods unfolded beneath their wings.

"...Shit."

Lock warnings screamed through every headset.

Laswell's voice crackled over the radio. "141, multiple UCAVs inbound. I'm trying to divert air support, but nothing can reach you in time."

Price gripped the radio. "How long?"

A pause.

"...Too long."

The first missile dropped.

"Move!" Price barked.

The explosion ripped across the road, forcing the convoy to scatter. Smoke swallowed the vehicles as more missiles armed overhead.

Ghost looked up, rifle useless against the aircraft.

"We're out of options."

Then the sky cracked.

A drone erupted into a fireball.

Everyone looked up.

Another drone exploded.

Then another.

A gray fighter burst through the clouds at impossible speed, banking hard as it tore through the swarm. Every pass ended with another drone falling from the sky in flames.

Within seconds, the hunters had become the hunted.

"Raptor..." Ghost muttered.

The F-22 screamed low over the convoy, its shockwave rattling every vehicle before climbing back into the sun.

Static hissed across every radio.

Then a calm, rough Texan drawl broke through.

"Afternoon, folks."

Another drone disappeared in the distance.

"Looks like y'all could use a little help."

The fighter settled into a protective orbit overhead.

"So keep haulin' ass..." A chuckle crackled over the frequency. "...'Cause y'all got a guardian angel up here in the skies."
